criteria.compound_specific: selected pair beats selected single on heldout in >=2 tasks; >=2 pairs must actually have been deployed
criteria.integrity: hashes of all frozen choices/predictions and data labels unchanged and independently recomputed
criteria.predictive_improvement: deployed method improves held-out Brier vs original baseline in >=4 of 5 tasks; mean Brier gain positive with 95% bootstrap interval lower bound >0; no regression >0.015

protocol.design: Train-only feature selection; 4-fold stratified CV Brier; all individual binary fields and unordered pairs; hierarchical smoothed frequencies; choose added pair only if CV reduction >=0.004 and improved in >=3/4 folds over current best; 40% holdout.
protocol.goal: cross-dataset predictive value of CV-gated joint binary signatures
protocol.name: HF-VALIDATION-005
protocol.sealing_limit: All datasets and labels are publicly available and not externally sequestered; local SHA commitment is not external timestamping
